notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added option to assign a key for aiming/blocking.
[*] The inscription for interaction with the forge has been brought to a common style.
[*] Fixed a bug with resetting control keys to default.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459277/3f3ff3a5e7c3ff3f171c663869c4b36ded1ebc11.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added invert Y option
[*] Improved texts
[*] Slightly improved performance
[*] Improved enemy AI
[*] Fixed some loot drop inaccuracies
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the player could not pick up an item from the floor near the forge and shop.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Update based on players' reviews:

[list]
[*] Now you can pick up items near the blacksmith if they fell on the floor.
[*] Crafting items now require significantly fewer resources.
[*] Improved physics of arrows from bows.
[*] Significantly increased damage from bows.
[*] Fixed the quick use panel for items on mission 4.
[*] Fixed typos in dialogues.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who plays Tale of Dark Lands!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A small game update related to the texts in the game:
[list]
[*] Fixed the text of the action key captions, when instead of the key the inscription {Key} was displayed.
[*] Fixed the translation of the text in several languages.
[*] Fixed a translation error, when some inscriptions in the game could be displayed in another language.
[/list]


Thanks a lot to everyone who plays "Tale of Dark Lands"!
This is my first big game and I would sincerely appreciate feedback!
